label: Studio Light
description: Controlled studio setups for portrait and product work — modifier, position and shadow behavior named in every item.

items.name: softbox-key
items.text: large octagonal softbox key at 45 degrees off camera and just above eye line, creamy highlight roll-off, the soft-edged nose shadow falling toward the far cheek

items.name: rembrandt
items.text: classic Rembrandt lighting, key high and to the side leaving a small triangle of light on the shadowed cheek, eyes catching light in both sockets

items.name: butterfly
items.text: butterfly lighting from high front, the symmetrical glamour shadow directly under nose and chin, cheekbones lifted into the light

items.name: clamshell
items.text: clamshell beauty lighting, soft key above and reflector fill below erasing texture, luminous even skin with twin catchlights

items.name: rim-kicker
items.text: twin rim kickers from behind at head height, bright edge highlights tracing shoulders and hair, separating the subject cleanly from the dark background

items.name: gelled-duotone
items.text: opposing gelled strobes, teal from one side and magenta from the other, the two colors meeting in a saturated seam along the center of the form

items.name: hard-bare-flash
items.text: hard bare direct flash from the camera position, crisp fashion-editorial shadows thrown flat and tight against the backdrop

items.name: ring-light
items.text: frontal ring light on the lens axis, shadowless beauty illumination with a signature circular catchlight in the eyes and a faint halo shadow behind

items.name: gridded-spot
items.text: a gridded spot picking the subject out of a black studio void, tight controlled spill, the beam edge feathering to nothing

items.name: white-cyclorama
items.text: even high-key light on a seamless white cyclorama, floating shadowless product look

items.name: light-painting-sweep
items.text: long-exposure light-painting sweeps wrapping the subject in ribbons of controlled highlight

items.name: window-flag-negative
items.text: single soft window source with black negative fill deepening the shadow side, quiet cinematic contrast

items.name: beauty-dish
items.text: silver beauty dish just above the lens axis, crisp yet feathered light hugging the cheekbones, a tight round catchlight and rapid falloff under the jaw

items.name: book-light
items.text: a book light, strobe bounced into white board then pushed through a diffusion frame, the softest wrap a studio can make, shadows melting without a visible direction line

items.name: short-lighting
items.text: short lighting, the key thrown onto the far side of the face so the camera-side cheek falls into shadow, the face narrowed and sculpted with the background held a stop darker

items.name: strip-speculars
items.text: two vertical strip softboxes flanked behind the subject, drawing long unbroken specular bands down glass, bodywork or skin — the product-studio move that defines a glossy form against black

items.name: overhead-scrim
items.text: one large scrim directly overhead with a low backlight skimming from behind, soft top-light pooling into the tabletop while steam and rim edges catch the back edge-light
